title: PARN and TOE1 constitute a 3′ end maturation module for nuclear non-coding RNAs
author: Son, Ahyeon
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Culture HeLa cells
steps.instruction: Grow HeLa cells in DMEM (Welgene) supplemented with 9% fetal bovine serum (Welgene) under standard conditions.

steps.title: Transfect with siRNA
steps.instruction: Transfect the cultured HeLa cells with 20 nM siRNA using Lipofectamine 3000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific) for four days. Use equal amounts of four different siRNAs for each single knockdown. For combinatorial knockdowns, mix multiple siRNA pools so that each pool is at a final concentration of 20 nM.

steps.title: Extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and extract total RNA with TRIzol reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific) following the manufacturer’s protocol, then treat the RNA with DNase I (Takara).

steps.title: Prepare mTAIL‑seq libraries
steps.instruction: Construct mTAIL‑seq libraries from the DNase‑treated RNA as described in Lim et al., 2016.

steps.title: Sequence cDNA libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the amplified cDNA libraries on an Illumina MiSeq platform, spiking in 50 % PhiX control library (Illumina).

steps.title: Process sequencing data
steps.instruction: Process the raw intensity and sequence files (including spike‑ins) with Tailseeker 3.1.7 according to its standard workflow. The source code and container images are available from Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/record/887547; doi:10.5281/zenodo.887546).
